chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: Herman Chittison with Zack White and on radio
summary: Chittison, with long fingers, played with Zack White, was on radio in Newport, Kentucky, and became a society pianist.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: What's this other piano player that you met after Tatum?

Herman Chittison was a wonderful pianist. He worked with Zack Whyte. He didn't stay with the band long after I was there because he had a radio program over in Newport News over there in Kentucky -- not Newport News but just Newport, Kentucky.
He got to be on the radio over there and he stayed on that station for quite a while, quite a long time. That was before he came to New York.
And I think behind playing in radio there I think he got the break in New York, too.
You see? And he was -- he had the longest fingers, and he was a little guy and he had long, very slender fingers and he could reach tenths.
I'm still talking about Herman. And a real quiet guy. And he came to New York and he just made it.
He played -- What did he play mostly, in clubs and then --
That's right. He was that type of piano -- just like you heard him play on 'Crime Photographer.'
Exactly. He could sit down and relax you, you know.
